description: Turn ingest on or off (File > Project Settings > Ingest Settings), choose scratch disk folders (Scratch Disks), and pause or resume refreshing growing files. Settings are one undo step; pausing growing files is not undoable

ingestEnabled.description: Run the project's ingest operation (copy, transcode or create proxies, as set in Premiere Pro) on import

pauseGrowing.description: true pauses refreshing growing files (media still being written); false resumes

scratchDisks.description: Scratch disk folders to change. Each is "same_as_project", "my_documents" or an absolute path of an existing folder

name: set_project_media_settings
title: Set Project Media Settings
